Interface Codec<T>

Type Parameters:
T - the type this codec converts to and from bytes
public interface Codec<T>
A pure byte codec, being two total functions between a value and its bytes.

Codecs are the only serialization vocabulary user logic sees. Bridge a Kafka serde in through fromSerde(Serde, String).

A codec is never invoked with null. Null keys and null values pass through the runtime untouched, so encode(T) and decode(byte[]) may assume their argument is present.

    • fromSerde

      static <T> Codec<T> fromSerde(org.apache.kafka.common.serialization.Serde<T> serde, String topic)
      Bridges a Kafka serde into a codec.

      The topic name is fixed at bridge time, because serdes take it per call and schema-registry serdes derive their subjects from it. Use one bridged codec per topic.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type the serde converts to and from bytes
      Parameters:
      serde - the serde to bridge
      topic - the topic name to pass on every serde call
      Returns:
      the codec
